divergence: F&O 4.7.4 calls the grouping regular only when "every position in the integer part of the sub-picture that is a positive integer multiple of G is occupied by a grouping-separator" — here it is not, so the recorded positions are applied literally instead of being extrapolated. jsonata-js asks only for the first positions.length multiples of the gcd and extrapolates; the W3C QT3 suite pins both directions in numberformat310/312 and numberformat318/319 (jsntrs-4fr follow-up, wave-6 spec audit)
